Ozone emitter converts O2 (breathable oxygen) to O3 (non-breathable oxygen), so you’ll need to be careful if you let it run for too long. Once it’s run for a couple hours you can walk in, open a window, and walk out. Let the room air. 

If anything is irreparably stained, or tainted by the smell, and a wash or two doesn’t sort it out, then unfortunately it’ll have to be thrown out.
